messages:
Ravi: quick thread to lock the benchmark hero + routing. need: hero chart, 3 demo clips (<=60s), and lead rules. deadline tomorrow AM.
Claire: hero = single scatter showing latency (x) vs $/1k tokens (y). highlight two bands: "Real-time (SLA)" and "Cost-optimized". add microcopy: "Illustrative results; actual may vary by prompt".
Sofia: agree. add small inline table under chart with 3 example slices: Chat Support, Document Search, Batch Embeddings (with rounded ranges).
Ethan: demos: 1) low-latency chat (sub-300ms), 2) high-throughput embeddings, 3) fallback to quantized model. map each demo to chart callouts.
Ravi: routing: consider high-intent triggers = pricing click, demo request, form select Dedicated/Private. route high-intent to SDR_A. others -> nurture. capture `expected_monthly_tokens` and `latency_priority`.
Claire: CTA A/B: A: "See your latency & cost" B: "Run a quick benchmark". my vote A for clarity.
Sofia: legal ok with the microcopy. also recommend a tiny tooltip: "Measured p50 on sample prompts".
infra-bot: Reminder: ensure analytics events: hero_view, cta_click, form_submit and experiment key bench_launch_v3.
Ethan: i'll record clips at 2pm. will leave raw recordings for reels.
Ravi: owners: Claire = visuals & CTAs (due noon), Sofia = copy + form fields (due 10am), Ethan = demos (due 5pm). I'll assemble landing and wire experiment.
Claire: uploading first static PNG in ~2hrs. will include SVG for social.
Sofia: drafting nurture sequences now; will post to #content-review.
Ravi: thanks team. keep replies short here. :rocket:
